body:
## Pull request overview

This PR completes the remaining “detail page roadmap” features in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` by expanding the detail schema/types and adding UI components/behaviors (auto-related discovery, auto-tabs, section groups, header highlights, and enhanced related lists), along with tests and roadmap updates.

**Changes:**
- Extend `DetailViewSchema`/types to support `autoDiscoverRelated`, `autoTabs`, `sectionGroups`, and `highlightFields`.
- Add `SectionGroup` + `HeaderHighlight` components and wire them into `DetailView` rendering (including auto-generated tabs).
- Enhance `RelatedList` with row actions plus client-side filtering/sorting/pagination; add tests and update `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/views.ts | Adds new protocol types (`SectionGroup`, `HighlightField`) and new `DetailViewSchema` props (`autoDiscoverRelated`, `autoTabs`, etc.). |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports new types from `@object-ui/types`. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/useDetailTranslation.ts | Adds fallback i18n keys for new UI strings. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx | Exports new components and their prop types from the plugin entrypoint. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Implements auto-discovered related lists, auto tab layout, section group rendering, and header highlight rendering. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx | Adds row edit/delete callbacks plus client-side filter/sort/pagination UI/logic. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/SectionGroup.tsx | New collapsible grouping component for multiple `DetailSection`s. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx | New “key fields” highlight banner component. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/roadmap-features.test.tsx | Integration-style tests covering the roadmap features. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/SectionGroup.test.tsx | Unit tests for `SectionGroup`. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HeaderHighlight.test.tsx | Unit tests for `HeaderHighlight`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the previously “Remaining” detail roadmap items as completed. |
</details>

`autoDiscoverRelated` computes `objectName` and `referenceField` for discovered relations, but `effectiveRelated` discards them and returns `{ title, type, data: [] }` with no `api` or other metadata. As a result, the “auto-discovered related lists” render as empty lists and can’t be fetched via `dataSource`. Consider extending the `DetailViewSchema['related']` item type to carry the discovered metadata (e.g., `objectName`/`referenceField` or a generated `api`) and have `RelatedList`/DetailView use it to load real related records.
```suggestion
      objectName: r.objectName,
      referenceField: r.referenceField,
```

The new `detail.*` keys were added to `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, but they don’t exist in the locale dictionaries under `packages/i18n/src/locales/*` (e.g., `detail.activity`, `detail.pageOf`, `detail.filterPlaceholder`). When an `I18nProvider` is present this will likely surface as missing translation keys. Please add these keys to all supported locale files (or remove unused keys).

Pagination state is only reset when `filterText`/`sortField`/`sortDirection` change. If `relatedData` changes (e.g., after an API fetch or when `data` prop changes) while `currentPage` points past the new `totalPages`, `paginatedData` can become empty even though there are records. Consider clamping/resetting `currentPage` when `relatedData` (or `totalPages`) changes.

These tests overwrite `window.confirm` but never restore the original implementation. This can leak state into later tests and make failures order-dependent. Store the original `window.confirm` and restore it in an `afterEach`, or use `vi.spyOn(window, 'confirm').mockReturnValue(...)` so Vitest can restore mocks automatically.
